title: Learn about Gemini Notebook’s plans - Gemini Notebook Help

facts.fact: Gemini Notebook Standard allows 100 notebooks per user.
facts.quote: | **Notebooks** | 100/user | 200/user | 500/user | 500/user | 500/user |

facts.fact: Gemini Notebook in Plus allows 200 notebooks per user.
facts.quote: | **Notebooks** | 100/user | 200/user | 500/user | 500/user | 500/user |

facts.fact: Gemini Notebook in Pro, Ultra (20 TB Plan) and Ultra (30 TB Plan) each allow 500 notebooks per user.
facts.quote: | **Notebooks** | 100/user | 200/user | 500/user | 500/user | 500/user |

facts.fact: Gemini Notebook Standard allows 50 sources per notebook.
facts.quote: | **Sources** | 50/notebook | 100/notebook | 300/notebook | 500/notebook | 600/notebook |

facts.fact: Gemini Notebook in Plus allows 100 sources per notebook.
facts.quote: | **Sources** | 50/notebook | 100/notebook | 300/notebook | 500/notebook | 600/notebook |

facts.fact: Gemini Notebook in Pro allows 300 sources per notebook.
facts.quote: | **Sources** | 50/notebook | 100/notebook | 300/notebook | 500/notebook | 600/notebook |

facts.fact: Gemini Notebook in Ultra (20 TB Plan) allows 500 sources per notebook.
facts.quote: | **Sources** | 50/notebook | 100/notebook | 300/notebook | 500/notebook | 600/notebook |

facts.fact: Gemini Notebook in Ultra (30 TB Plan) allows 600 sources per notebook.
facts.quote: | **Sources** | 50/notebook | 100/notebook | 300/notebook | 500/notebook | 600/notebook |

facts.fact: The page states that the usage limits are subject to change.
facts.quote: **Usage Limits (Subject to Change)**

facts.fact: Sharing a notebook does not change the source limit for any collaborator.
facts.quote: _Sharing a notebook does not change the source limit for any collaborator._

facts.fact: Daily quotas on a plan reset after 24 hours, and monthly quotas reset after 30 days.
facts.quote: If your plan is on daily quotas, these reset after 24 hours. Monthly quotas reset after 30 days.

facts.fact: Watermark removal is not available on Gemini Notebook Standard or Plus, and is available on Pro and both Ultra plans.
facts.quote: | **Watermark Removal** | No  | No  | Yes\* | Yes\* | Yes\* |

facts.fact: A visible watermark is applied automatically to Gemini Notebook for users who reside in India, South Korea, or Vietnam.
facts.quote: A visible watermark will be applied automatically if you reside in India, South Korea, or Vietnam.

facts.fact: Advanced sharing is available to paid users, while custom chat and analytics are available to everyone.
facts.quote: Advanced sharing available to paid users. Custom chat and analytics are available to everyone.

facts.fact: Gemini Notebook Standard can be used free of charge by signing up with a Gmail account.
facts.quote: Sign up free of charge by using your gmail account.

facts.fact: Early access to key features is Standard for the Standard plan, Early for Plus, and Priority for Pro and both Ultra plans.
facts.quote: | **Earlier Access to Key Features** | Standard | Early | Priority | Priority | Priority |

facts.fact: Gemini Notebook model access is described as basic access on Standard and Plus, higher access on Pro, and highest access on both Ultra plans.
facts.quote: | **Gemini Model** | **Access** to Gemini models | **Access** to Gemini models | **Higher** access to Gemini models | **Highest** access to Gemini models | **Highest** access to Gemini models |

facts.fact: Gemini Notebook data is not used to train Gemini Notebook unless the user provides feedback.
facts.quote: Your data is protected, and is not used to train Gemini Notebook unless you provide feedback.

facts.fact: For Google Workspace or Workspace for Education users, uploads, queries and model responses are not reviewed by human reviewers even when thumbs up or down feedback is given, and are not used to train AI models.
facts.quote: Your uploads, queries and the model's responses in Gemini Notebook will not be reviewed by human reviewers even when you provide thumbs up or down feedback, and will not be used to train AI models.

facts.fact: Some users may see a report, flashcards, infographic, slide deck, audio overview, or a video overview feature, depending on their plan or access.
facts.quote: Some users may see a report, flashcards, infographic, slide deck, audio overview, or a video overvie
